_comment: What a blinded run receives as its input, per task: which of the subject's files the
harness fetches from the dataset (a glob relative to the subject's directory, or from
the dataset's root when it starts with '/'; it must match exactly one file) or a fixed
`url` for a file that is not the dataset's (a template), the neutral name it is handed
over under (relative to input/<case>/), and the one sentence the prompt says about the
input. No subject, session or dataset name reaches the agent: the neutral names carry
none, the NIfTI header's descriptive fields are blanked and the JSON sidecar is not
shipped. Before the agent starts, the run keeps only its own task's neutral names and

structural-brain-extraction.scan: a T1-weighted MRI of the head

structural-brain-extraction-pediatric.scan: a T1-weighted MRI of a child's head

structural-brain-extraction-motion.scan: a T1-weighted MRI of the head, acquired while the head moved

structural-brain-extraction-7t.scan: a 7T MP2RAGE T1-weighted (UNI) image of the head

structural-brain-extraction-7t-nodura.scan: a 7T MP2RAGE T1-weighted (UNI) image of the head

structural-tissue-segmentation-7t.scan: a 7T MP2RAGE T1-weighted (UNI) image of the head

structural-mni-registration.scan: a T1-weighted MRI of the head, a tissue segmentation of it (1 = grey matter, 2 = white matter, 3 = CSF) and the MNI152NLin2009cAsym template at 1 mm
